svg.aria-label: About me: teacher first, engineer now. I build education technology that reaches 600k+ active students across Brazil and Panama.
svg.title: About me
svg.desc: Teacher first, engineer now. I build education technology that reaches more than 600 thousand active students across Brazil and Panama. I started in the classroom; today I ship AI, data and full-stack products for schools, and I train the people who use them. Next: make AI in education obvious, inclusive and measurable.

g.text: I build education technology that reaches 600k+ active students across Brazil and Panama.
I started in the classroom — today I ship AI, data and full-stack products for schools, and I
train the people who use them. Teacher empathy, engineer discipline, same job.
Next: make AI in education feel obvious, inclusive and measurable — and keep
building products that schools in Brazil and Latin America actually run every day.
open to build with people who care about education
